Lemma
[Smoothness of the length away from the zero set]

↗ lem:inner-product-vector-fields-smooth

1. ch2:2.2For smooth $X$ on a Riemannian manifold with or without boundary, $|X|$ is smooth at every point where $X$ is nonzero, hence on the open nonzero set.
Proof

↗ lem:inner-product-vector-fields-smooth \sketch At $p$ with $X_p\ne 0$, positivity gives $\langle X_p,X_p\rangle >0$; the pairing is smooth by Lemma 4, and the square root is smooth on $(0,\infty )$.

□

A local frame $(E_i)$ is orthonormal when $\langle E_i,E_j\rangle =\delta _{ij}$. With dual coframe $(e^i)$, this is equivalent to $g=\sum _i(e^i)^2$.
